us_esta.title: ESTA required (USA)
us_esta.body: Apply for your ESTA online before flying to the US. Approval is usually quick but can take up to 72h.

uk_eta.title: UK ETA required
uk_eta.body: You need an Electronic Travel Authorisation to enter the UK. Apply online before you travel.

schengen_etias.title: ETIAS (Europe)
schengen_etias.body: An ETIAS travel authorisation may be required for the Schengen area. Check the official site before booking.

canada_eta.title: Canada eTA required
canada_eta.body: Visa-exempt air travellers need an eTA to enter Canada. Apply online — it is usually approved within minutes.

australia_eta.title: Australia ETA required
australia_eta.body: An Electronic Travel Authority is required to visit Australia. Apply via the official app before departure.

india_evisa.title: India e-Visa
india_evisa.body: Apply for an India e-Visa online a few weeks before your trip.

brazil_visa.title: Brazil visa
brazil_visa.body: A visa may be required for Brazil depending on your nationality. Check processing times early.

china_visa.title: China visa
china_visa.body: Most travellers need a visa for mainland China. Apply well ahead — processing takes about a week.

passport_validity_6mo.title: Passport must be valid 6 months
passport_validity_6mo.body: Many destinations require your passport to be valid for at least 6 months beyond your stay.

passport_validity_3mo.title: Passport validity (Schengen)
passport_validity_3mo.body: Schengen countries require your passport to be valid for at least 3 months beyond your departure date.

schengen_90_180.title: Schengen 90/180 rule
schengen_90_180.body: Visa-exempt visitors can stay up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen area.

jp_visa_free_90.title: Japan visa-free stay
jp_visa_free_90.body: Many nationalities can visit Japan visa-free for up to 90 days.

yellow_fever_zone.title: Yellow fever vaccination
yellow_fever_zone.body: A yellow fever certificate may be required or recommended for this destination. Check with a travel clinic.

cash_10k_eu.title: Declare cash over €10,000
cash_10k_eu.body: You must declare cash of €10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU.

cash_10k_us.title: Declare cash over $10,000
cash_10k_us.body: You must declare currency of $10,000 or more when entering or leaving the US.

thailand_visa_free.title: Thailand visa-free stay
thailand_visa_free.body: Many nationalities can enter Thailand visa-free for tourism. Check the latest allowed duration.

travel_insurance_schengen.title: Travel insurance (Schengen)
travel_insurance_schengen.body: Travel medical insurance is recommended (and sometimes required) for the Schengen area.

vaccine_routine.title: Check routine vaccines
vaccine_routine.body: Make sure your routine vaccinations are up to date before traveling.
